note: The capture that can tell a FRACTION from a PERCENT on the tax path. GoPlus sends gp.buyTax "0.04" while QuickIntel sends tokenDynamicDetails.buyTax "4.0" for the SAME 4 percent buy tax on this token, so the two scales are visible side by side in one document. Every previously committed pair-details fixture carries a tax of 0 or null, which cannot discriminate the two: reading a fraction as a percent renders a 4 percent tax as 0.04 percent, in the direction that makes a taxed token look clean. Corroborated on FLOKI 0xcf0C122c6b73ff809C693DB761e7BaeBe62b6a2E (gp 0.0029 / 0.003).
